item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot weather to southern China during the weekend to early next week, while showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. With the anticyclone aloft weakening, and under the influence of an upper level disturbance, the weather will be unsettled with occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Songda will move across the East China Sea today and tomorrow.
